name: Willa
self_text: Hey there! I’m a Kenyan guy in my early 30s who loves a relaxed photo walk at a moderate pace. I bring my phone for shooting and enjoy chatting about all the gear we use. I’m happy to share some post‑processing tips too, and I’m up for swapping portraits of each other. I’ve got Saturday afternoon and Sunday afternoon free for a good shoot. Oh, and in my spare time I swing dance – it’s a fun way to keep moving!

requests.request_text: I need you to be available either Saturday afternoon or Sunday afternoon, and I need you to be okay with not taking portraits of each other or with no gear debates. I'd strongly prefer that you are the one who learns post‑processing from me, though it's not a requirement. A nice if you’re into a relaxed photo walk, but no big deal.
